description: Inspect one of your persistent Switch Editor projects. Omit project_id for your latest project; include_payload=true returns its full editable state.

include_payload.description: true returns the full editable state (media, timeline tracks and clips, studio); false (default) returns counts only.

project_id.description: The Editor project id from list_editor_projects. Omit for your latest project.

name: get_editor_project
title: Get Editor Project
